posts.title: Where are we on the sigmoid curve?
posts.description: In February 2023 Tom Scott said AI was on a new sigmoid curve and that he had no idea how far along it we were. Almost four years later, I try to answer him: for capability, for adoption and for the money. (14 min read)

posts.title: Can ElevenLabs fix my cold?
posts.description: I got sick, recorded my strained voice and pushed it through ElevenLabs v4: my voice clone, other voices, audio tags, a movie trailer and a Swedish dub. Every clip is in the post. (6 min read)

posts.title: There's a module for that
posts.description: Coding agents write a custom module before they look on drupal.org. I documented every Drupal 11 module for agents and put it behind a local MCP server. The write-up of my Drupal AI Learners Club talk. (16 min read)
